focus: 連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤~Relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground

units.anchor: 方格置換面積~Square grid replacement area
units.title: 方格置換面積~Square grid replacement area
units.mechanism: 碎石樁和原土共同承擔荷載，樁面積占單元面積的比例是配置起點。平均直徑不一定代表每一深度的有效斷面，網格邊界與漏樁也會改變實際置換。假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。~Stone columns and native soil share load, making area replacement a starting descriptor. Mean diameter does not establish effective section at every depth, while boundaries and missing columns alter actual replacement. For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell.
units.verify: 用竣工坐標與材料記錄核對每個單元，檢查不同深度的可能縮頸。圖面列出場界、障礙及漏樁位置，不能以全場平均替代關鍵基礎下的局部配置。同時排除以下干擾原因：若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。~Reconcile as-built coordinates and material records by cell, checking possible necking with depth. Mark boundaries, obstructions and missing columns instead of substituting a site average for local foundation coverage. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads.
units.failure: 若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。~Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads.
units.misconception: 只要方格置換面積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for square grid replacement area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接方格置換面積時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用竣工坐標與材料記錄核對每個單元，檢查不同深度的可能縮頸。圖面列出場界、障礙及漏樁位置，不能以全場平均替代關鍵基礎下的局部配置。~When handing over square grid replacement area, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile as-built coordinates and material records by cell, checking possible necking with depth. Mark boundaries, obstructions and missing columns instead of substituting a site average for local foundation coverage.

units.anchor: 粒料側向拘束~Aggregate lateral confinement
units.title: 粒料側向拘束~Aggregate lateral confinement
units.mechanism: 碎石柱不是可獨立受壓的鋼筋混凝土樁，粒料抗剪需要周圍土體提供拘束。理想摩擦材料的主應力比顯示拘束重要性，但不能直接當整根柱的承載公式。假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。~A stone column is not an independently supported reinforced-concrete pile. Aggregate shear resistance needs surrounding confinement; an ideal frictional stress ratio illustrates that dependence rather than providing a whole-column capacity formula. For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.
units.verify: 對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。同時排除以下干擾原因：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。~Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.
units.failure: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。~Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.
units.misconception: 只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接粒料側向拘束時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。~When handing over aggregate lateral confinement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement.

units.anchor: 等應變荷載分配~Equal strain load sharing
units.title: 等應變荷載分配~Equal strain load sharing
units.mechanism: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。等應變單元可說明平衡，應力集中比必須有分析或試驗依據。假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。~Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. An equal-strain cell illustrates equilibrium, but its concentration ratio requires analytical or experimental support. For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa. Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.
units.verify: 以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。同時排除以下干擾原因：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。~Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.
units.failure: 把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。~Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.
units.misconception: 只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接等應變荷載分配時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。~When handing over equal strain load sharing, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model.

units.anchor: 柱體排水通量~Column drainage flow
units.title: 柱體排水通量~Column drainage flow
units.mechanism: 高透水柱體可提供排水路徑，但是否有效取決於連通、濾層及周圍土進水能力。達西通量只描述選定柱段，不能以柱材高透水性證明全地盤迅速消散孔壓。假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。~A permeable column provides drainage only with connectivity, filtering and inflow from the surrounding soil. Darcy flow describes a selected segment; high aggregate permeability alone does not prove rapid pressure dissipation throughout the ground. For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity. Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.
units.verify: 檢查粒料與周圍土的濾層相容性，並量測柱內外孔壓的時間差。核對上部排水出口是否暢通，不能只以供料場的滲透試驗替代整個排水系統驗證。同時排除以下干擾原因：細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。~Check filter compatibility with native soil and measure pressure lag inside and outside columns. Verify outlet continuity rather than using quarry permeability tests as acceptance of the complete drainage system. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground.
units.failure: 細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。~Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground.
units.misconception: 只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接柱體排水通量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查粒料與周圍土的濾層相容性，並量測柱內外孔壓的時間差。核對上部排水出口是否暢通，不能只以供料場的滲透試驗替代整個排水系統驗證。~When handing over column drainage flow, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check filter compatibility with native soil and measure pressure lag inside and outside columns. Verify outlet continuity rather than using quarry permeability tests as acceptance of the complete drainage system.

units.anchor: 成柱材料體積~Column material volume
units.title: 成柱材料體積~Column material volume
units.mechanism: 理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。材料超量或不足均需解釋，不能直接把卡車運送體積當竣工直徑證明。假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。~Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses. Both excess and shortage need explanation; truck volume alone does not demonstrate as-built diameter. For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery. Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.
units.verify: 以分深度施工紀錄、投入量與材料體積換算核對成柱連續性，異常區配合適用檢測。保存實際深度與平台高程，避免起算面不同導致長度差被誤認成超耗。同時排除以下干擾原因：單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。~Reconcile depth records, quantities and volume conversions to assess continuity, investigating anomalies with suitable tests. Preserve depth and platform datum so different starting elevations are not mistaken for excessive consumption. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement.
units.failure: 單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。~Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement.
units.misconception: 只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接成柱材料體積時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以分深度施工紀錄、投入量與材料體積換算核對成柱連續性，異常區配合適用檢測。保存實際深度與平台高程，避免起算面不同導致長度差被誤認成超耗。~When handing over column material volume, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile depth records, quantities and volume conversions to assess continuity, investigating anomalies with suitable tests. Preserve depth and platform datum so different starting elevations are not mistaken for excessive consumption.

units.anchor: 複合地盤壓縮~Composite ground compression
units.title: 複合地盤壓縮~Composite ground compression
units.mechanism: 改良後沉陷取決於有效複合模數與未改善下層，簡化一維估算只適用指定應力範圍。柱土分配模型和模數選定需相容，不能把石料模數直接當整片地盤模數。假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。~Settlement depends on composite stiffness and untreated deeper layers. A one-dimensional estimate applies within a specified stress range; load sharing and modulus must agree, rather than substituting aggregate modulus for the entire ground. For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression. Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression.
units.verify: 比較載重試驗、分層沉陷與地層模型，確認模數代表實際應力範圍及排水條件。將改良層與下伏未改良層分項列出，不以小試區結果遮蔽深層貢獻。同時排除以下干擾原因：若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。~Compare load tests, layer settlements and stratigraphy to verify modulus over the real stress and drainage range. List improved and untreated contributions separately instead of allowing a small trial to conceal deep compression. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement.
units.failure: 若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。~Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement.
units.misconception: 只要複合地盤壓縮符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for composite ground compression removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接複合地盤壓縮時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較載重試驗、分層沉陷與地層模型，確認模數代表實際應力範圍及排水條件。將改良層與下伏未改良層分項列出，不以小試區結果遮蔽深層貢獻。~When handing over composite ground compression, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare load tests, layer settlements and stratigraphy to verify modulus over the real stress and drainage range. List improved and untreated contributions separately instead of allowing a small trial to conceal deep compression.

units.anchor: 排水時間尺度~Drainage time scale
units.title: 排水時間尺度~Drainage time scale
units.mechanism: 排水能否跟上載重歷程需要比較時間尺度，不只比較滲透係數大小。擴散估算用於提出問題，實際徑向幾何、塗抹區及非線性都可能改變消散時間。假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。~Whether drainage keeps pace with loading requires comparing timescales, not permeability alone. A diffusion estimate frames the question; radial geometry, smear and nonlinearity can substantially change dissipation. For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake. Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake.
units.verify: 以實測孔壓消散曲線校準係數及邊界，再和設計載重持續時間比較。對快速循環荷載保留瞬態分析，由岩土工程師確認排水效益是否可納入設計。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。~Calibrate coefficients and boundaries with observed dissipation, then compare with design loading duration. Rapid cyclic loading needs transient assessment before a geotechnical engineer credits a drainage benefit. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking.
units.failure: 若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。~Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking.
units.misconception: 只要排水時間尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for drainage time scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接排水時間尺度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以實測孔壓消散曲線校準係數及邊界，再和設計載重持續時間比較。對快速循環荷載保留瞬態分析，由岩土工程師確認排水效益是否可納入設計。~When handing over drainage time scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Calibrate coefficients and boundaries with observed dissipation, then compare with design loading duration. Rapid cyclic loading needs transient assessment before a geotechnical engineer credits a drainage benefit.

units.anchor: 柱端壓力尺度~Column toe pressure scale
units.title: 柱端壓力尺度~Column toe pressure scale
units.mechanism: 柱端荷載和側向傳遞共同決定底部應力，不能假設所有荷載都傳至硬層。端面平均壓力只是一個局部需求量，若柱端坐落軟土，需考慮刺入及下部壓縮。假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。~Toe load and side transfer govern base stress; not all load automatically reaches a hard stratum. Mean toe pressure is a local demand, and a toe in soft soil requires checks for punching and underlying compression. For toe load P=300kN and D=0.8m, qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa, about597kPa. Toe load need not equal the column-head load. A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For toe load P=300kN and D=0.8m, qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa, about597kPa. Toe load need not equal the column-head load.
units.verify: 以地層及施工深度確認柱端位置，將荷載傳遞分析和分層沉陷比較。對軟硬交界及局部薄硬層特別檢查，不因探頭短暫阻力增加就認定已達可靠持力層。同時排除以下干擾原因：薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。~Confirm toe location from stratigraphy and installation depth, comparing transfer analysis with layer movement. Examine thin hard lenses and transitions rather than treating a brief resistance increase as a reliable bearing stratum. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported.
units.failure: 薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。~A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported.
units.misconception: 只要柱端壓力尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for column toe pressure scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接柱端壓力尺度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以地層及施工深度確認柱端位置，將荷載傳遞分析和分層沉陷比較。對軟硬交界及局部薄硬層特別檢查，不因探頭短暫阻力增加就認定已達可靠持力層。~When handing over column toe pressure scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Confirm toe location from stratigraphy and installation depth, comparing transfer analysis with layer movement. Examine thin hard lenses and transitions rather than treating a brief resistance increase as a reliable bearing stratum.

units.anchor: 邊緣柱與內柱~Edge and interior columns
units.title: 邊緣柱與內柱~Edge and interior columns
units.mechanism: 邊緣柱的拘束、荷載分配及排水邊界和內柱不同，不應一律用單元對稱模型。試驗結果比較要說明位置及載重範圍，避免把邊界效應誤認為施工品質差。假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。~Edge columns differ in confinement, load sharing and drainage from interior columns, limiting symmetric-cell assumptions. Comparisons need position and loading extent so boundary effects are not automatically labelled poor workmanship. At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor. An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor.
units.verify: 在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。由設計者評估實際基礎邊界，不把單一位置試驗代表全場每一根柱。同時排除以下干擾原因：邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。~Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. The designer evaluates real foundation boundaries rather than using one tested location to represent all columns. Also rule out the following competing explanation: An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners.
units.failure: 邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。~An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners.
units.misconception: 只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接邊緣柱與內柱時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。在試區保留邊緣與內部位置的載重及位移資料，核對周圍土與墊層連續性。由設計者評估實際基礎邊界，不把單一位置試驗代表全場每一根柱。~When handing over edge and interior columns, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain edge and interior load-movement records, checking surrounding soil and mat continuity. The designer evaluates real foundation boundaries rather than using one tested location to represent all columns.

units.anchor: 排水堵塞後孔壓~Pressure after drain blockage
units.title: 排水堵塞後孔壓~Pressure after drain blockage
units.mechanism: 長期排水維護決定柱體作為水力通路是否仍有效，出口淤塞可使水頭回升。孔壓增量應和荷載及有效應力一起評估，不能把碎石存在視為永遠暢通。假設局部排水水頭增加Δh=2m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×2=19.62kPa，約19.6kPa；未改變總應力時有效應力同量下降。若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。~Long-term outlet maintenance determines whether columns remain effective hydraulic paths. Blockage can raise head, and the resulting pressure change must be assessed with loading and effective stress rather than assuming permanent drainage. For a local head increase Δh=2m, Δu=9.81×2=19.62kPa, about19.6kPa. Effective stress falls by the same amount if total stress is unchanged. Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Water-level recovery combined with added load can accelerate settlement or local column bulging.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設局部排水水頭增加Δh=2m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×2=19.62kPa，約19.6kPa；未改變總應力時有效應力同量下降。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a local head increase Δh=2m, Δu=9.81×2=19.62kPa, about19.6kPa. Effective stress falls by the same amount if total stress is unchanged.
units.verify: 交接出口位置、維護通道及基準孔壓，定期比對水位與降雨反應。發現水頭回升時應調查淤積和外部補注，修復方案由維護及岩土責任人共同確認。同時排除以下干擾原因：若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。~Handover records outlets, maintenance access and baseline pressure, with periodic rainfall-response checks. Investigate sediment and external recharge when head rises; maintenance and geotechnical leads jointly approve remedial action. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Water-level recovery combined with added load can accelerate settlement or local column bulging.
units.failure: 若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。~Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Water-level recovery combined with added load can accelerate settlement or local column bulging.
units.misconception: 只要排水堵塞後孔壓符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for pressure after drain blockage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接排水堵塞後孔壓時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。交接出口位置、維護通道及基準孔壓，定期比對水位與降雨反應。發現水頭回升時應調查淤積和外部補注，修復方案由維護及岩土責任人共同確認。~When handing over pressure after drain blockage, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Handover records outlets, maintenance access and baseline pressure, with periodic rainfall-response checks. Investigate sediment and external recharge when head rises; maintenance and geotechnical leads jointly approve remedial action.

title: 振動碎石樁施工~Vibro-replacement stone columns
summary: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。方格間距固定2m，假設直徑由0.8增加10%至0.88m，置換率由0.1257增為0.1521，比例增加21%而非10%；實際直徑與深度連續性仍需證據，不能只用供料量保證。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. At fixed2m square spacing, increasing assumed diameter from0.8 to0.88m by10% raises replacement from0.1257 to0.1521, a21% rather than10% increase. Actual diameter and continuity still require evidence rather than a delivered-material guarantee. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤的背景。美國聯邦公路管理局列出碎石樁設計施工手冊（1985）。基督城南部高速公路開始碎石樁試驗（2010）。地盤改良第一冊收錄粒料柱方法背景（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. FHWA lists its stone-column design and construction manual (1985). Christchurch Southern Motorway begins stone-column trials (2010). Ground Modification Volume I includes aggregate-column methods (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression.
